Austria / CITY EDIT

Ten cities.
Very different weekends.

Choose a break by mood, scale and travel time. These cities are starting points, not a ranking.

01 / Austria

Vienna

Vienna combines Habsburg palaces, major art collections and a long-established coffeehouse culture.

Explore Vienna ↗02 / Austria

Salzburg

Salzburg's baroque old town and hilltop fortress frame a city closely associated with Mozart.

Explore Salzburg ↗03 / Austria

Innsbruck

Innsbruck places an imperial old town directly beneath the rugged Nordkette mountain range.

Explore Innsbruck ↗04 / Austria

Graz

Graz combines a historic roofscape with striking contemporary architecture beside the Mur.

Explore Graz ↗05 / Austria

Linz

Linz connects its Danube setting with digital art and contemporary museum architecture.

Explore Linz ↗06 / Austria

Klagenfurt

Klagenfurt combines a historic city centre with access to Lake Wörthersee.

Explore Klagenfurt ↗07 / Austria

Bregenz

Bregenz combines Lake Constance scenery with contemporary art and a historic upper town.

Explore Bregenz ↗08 / Austria

Eisenstadt

Eisenstadt's palaces and musical landmarks reflect Joseph Haydn's association with the Esterházy court.

Explore Eisenstadt ↗09 / Austria

St. Pölten

St. Pölten contrasts a baroque civic centre with modern cultural buildings in Lower Austria's capital.

Explore St. Pölten ↗10 / Austria

Villach

Villach combines colourful old-town streets with riverside walks and cycle routes along the Drau.

Explore Villach ↗
